answer: Locks are recorded in quill, expire in pigment, and nebula lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 193 aliases therefore needs 68 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The per-identity price is 114 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
